गध् गध्, cl. 4. P. गध्यति, to be
mixed.

गाध् गाध् [cf. गाह्, to which this root
is related], cl. 1. A. गाधते, जगाधे,
गाधिष्यते, अगाधिष्ट, गाधितुम्, to stand firmly,
to stay, remain; to set out; to seek, to search or inquire
for, to desire; to compile, string or heap together.

गध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be seized, to be
gained as booty.

गाधि गाधि, इस्, m., N. of the father of
Viśvā-mitra and king of Kānyakubja, also called
गाधिन्; (अयस्), m. pl. the descendants of Gādhi.
—गाधि-ज, अस्, m. Gādhi's son, a N. of Viśvā-
mitra. गाधिन्, ई, m. (a later form for गाथिन्,
q. v.), = गाधि.
—गाधि-नगर, अम्, n. Gādhi's
city, an epithet of Kānyakubja.
—गाधि-नन्दन,
अस्, m. the son of Gādhi, an epithet of Viśvā-mitra;
also गाधि-पुत्र, अस्, m., गाधि-भू, ऊस्, m., गाधि-
[]
सूनु, उस्, m.
—गाधि-पुर, अम्, n. Gādhi's city,
an epithet of Kānyakubja; [cf. गाधि-नगर.]

गाधेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of Viśvā-mitra;
(ई), f. a patronymic of Satyavatī.
